title: RAW UNREVIEWED: unfinished rubrication guide marks distinguish lexical symbols from letter initials
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. If the manuscript preserves physically bound guide marks for later enlarged initials or headings, completed and unfinished examples may reveal whether a small mark copies the first graphic component, abbreviates a whole heading, or names a production instruction. This could constrain the unit of encoding before any language assignment. No qualifying guide mark is asserted.

design.mechanism: Two-stage preparation reserves a text slot and leaves a small production guide that a later writing or decorating pass expands.
design.unit: Complete physically owned reserved slot, its guide mark and completed heading/initial, with counterparts on separate admitted leaves.
design.contrast: First-graphic-component guide versus whole-heading logogram versus production instruction unrelated to heading wording.
design.prediction: A fixed guide convention predicts the completed initial or entire heading in independent examples; shared guide with different continuations rejects whole-heading identity, while graphic mismatch rejects literal first-component copying.
design.scope: RAW proposal; physical guide ownership and two-stage manufacture are missing inputs. No chronology inferred from ink darkness, enlargement or current whitespace alone. IP052 label-as-heading-abbreviation and COL001 underpaint-note limits retained; this requires reserved-slot guide-to-completion evidence, not ordinary label/prose resemblance. No character sound, concrete meaning, new image admission or f116v access.
